name: lizard
description: Deploy and manage apps, databases, and infra on Lizard (lizard.build) from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy and manage apps and databases on Lizard
interface.longDescription: Connect Lizard once, then ask ChatGPT or Codex to ship a service from a GitHub repo, read logs, set secrets, scale replicas, attach a domain, or provision a managed Postgres/Redis/S3 addon — in plain words. Scoped to your own Lizard workspaces and projects.
defaultPrompt: Show the last 50 log lines for my-app on Lizard
